protein: BRCA1, breast cancer type 1 susceptibility protein; residues 2-302 scanned
readout: Homology-directed repair functional score (log2, wild type = 0)
assay_method: Multiplexed homology-directed repair assay: barcoded BRCA1 variants integrated at a single Flp-In site in HeLa-DR-FRT cells, endogenous BRCA1 depleted by siRNA, then cells sorted by flow cytometry into GFP-positive and GFP-negative populations. Enrich2 computes the functional score from variant abundance in the two pools, normalized to wild type and reported in log2 over four replicates.
remark: The reference sequence is UniProt P38398 unmodified, against which all 2,172 labels in the source verify at offset 0. The assay covers residues 2 to 302 only, the amino terminus, so 1,561 of the 1,863 positions carry no mutation and rest on the accession alone. There is no WT row: the shipped table holds only missense and nonsense variants, no synonymous ones, and the paper defines the Enrich2 functional score in log2 with 0 representing normal wild-type function, so wt_readout is 0 by that definition rather than by measurement. The 18 nonsense variants are dropped, a stop codon not being a substitution in this format. readout is the source's own average of four replicate scores; 288 variants are averaged from three replicates rather than four. This paper re-analyses and extends the authors' earlier assay of 1,056 substitutions in residues 2 to 192 with an improved pipeline and adds residues 193 to 302, so it supersedes that earlier set rather than duplicating it. Not extracted from this paper: the per-replicate columns, since the average is the value the classification rests on; and the remaining supplementary workbooks, which hold clinical variant comparisons, in-silico predictor concordance and assay-validation panels computed on top of this same score.
